name: Beginner
capability_description: Solve a one-step addition equation with a whole-number answer.

name: Trainee
capability_description: Solve a one-step addition or subtraction equation with whole numbers.

name: Explorer
capability_description: Solve a two-variable system formed from repeated addition and subtraction.

name: Challenger
capability_description: Solve a three-variable system formed from repeated addition and subtraction.

name: Ace
capability_description: Solve a one-step multiplication or exact-division equation with a whole-number answer.

name: Expert
capability_description: Solve a one-step exact-division equation with a whole-number answer.

name: Elite
capability_description: Solve a one-step equation using any supported arithmetic operation with a whole-number answer.

name: Champion
capability_description: Work with a two-variable system generated from addition and subtraction terms.

name: Master
capability_description: Work with a two-variable system that can include multiplication in its displayed form.
